definition_en: In a way that involves careful and logical examination of something.
example_en: She approached the problem analytically rather than emotionally.
example_uz: U muammoga hissiy emas, balki analitik tarzda yondashdi.

definition_en: In relation to the whole world; worldwide.
example_en: The company operates globally in over fifty countries.
example_uz: Kompaniya ellikdan ortiq mamlakatda global miqyosda faoliyat yuritadi.

definition_en: In a way that shows imagination and original ideas.
example_en: The students were encouraged to think creatively about the assignment.
example_uz: Talabalar topshiriq haqida ijodiy tarzda fikrlashga undaldi.

definition_en: In a new and original way that introduces fresh ideas.
example_en: The startup solved the problem innovatively using unfamiliar technology.
example_uz: Startap muammoni notanish texnologiya yordamida innovatsion tarzda hal qildi.

definition_en: A person who introduces new ideas, methods, or products.
example_en: She is considered one of the leading innovators in renewable energy.
example_uz: U qayta tiklanadigan energiya sohasidagi yetakchi innovatorlardan biri hisoblanadi.

definition_en: In a way that involves working together with others toward a shared goal.
example_en: The two departments worked collaboratively to finish the project on time.
example_uz: Ikki bo'lim loyihani vaqtida tugatish uchun hamkorlikda ishladi.

definition_en: A person who works with someone else to produce or create something.
example_en: He found a collaborator to help him write the research paper.
example_uz: U ilmiy maqola yozishda yordam beradigan hamkor topdi.

definition_en: Able to make people believe or do something through effective argument.
example_en: She gave a persuasive speech that changed everyone's opinion.
example_uz: U hammaning fikrini o'zgartirgan ishontiruvchi nutq so'zladi.

definition_en: In a manner that convinces people to believe or do something.
example_en: He argued persuasively for more funding in education.
example_uz: U ta'lim uchun ko'proq mablag' ajratish haqida ishontiruvchi tarzda bahs yuritdi.

definition_en: The quality of being able to convince people effectively.
example_en: The lawyer's persuasiveness won over the jury.
example_uz: Advokatning ishontirish qobiliyati hakamlar hay'atini o'ziga jalb qildi.

definition_en: Not correct or exact; containing errors.
example_en: The weather forecast was inaccurate; it rained instead of being sunny.
example_uz: Ob-havo bashorati noto'g'ri edi; quyoshli bo'lish o'rniga yomg'ir yog'di.

definition_en: A mistake or error; the state of being incorrect.
example_en: The report contained several inaccuracies that needed correcting.
example_uz: Hisobotda tuzatishni talab qiladigan bir nechta noaniqliklar bor edi.

definition_en: The quality of not being connected to or important for the matter at hand.
example_en: The judge dismissed the comment as an irrelevance to the case.
example_uz: Sudya izohni ishga aloqasi yo'q deb rad etdi.

definition_en: The quality of being too small or unimportant to be worth considering.
example_en: He felt a sense of insignificance next to the towering mountains.
example_uz: Baland tog'lar oldida u o'zini ahamiyatsizdek his qildi.

definition_en: Not achieving results with the minimum waste of time or resources.
example_en: The old machine was slow and inefficient compared to the new model.
example_uz: Eski mashina yangi modelga nisbatan sekin va samarasiz edi.

definition_en: The failure to use time, resources, or effort in the best possible way.
example_en: The audit revealed serious inefficiency in the company's processes.
example_uz: Audit kompaniya jarayonlarida jiddiy samarasizlikni aniqladi.

definition_en: Not producing the intended result or effect.
example_en: The new policy proved ineffective at reducing traffic.
example_uz: Yangi siyosat tirbandlikni kamaytirishda samarasiz bo'lib chiqdi.

definition_en: The state of not producing the desired or intended result.
example_en: Critics pointed to the ineffectiveness of the current approach.
example_uz: Tanqidchilar hozirgi yondashuvning samarasizligini ta'kidlashdi.

definition_en: Unwilling or unable to change or adapt.
example_en: The rules here are inflexible; there are no exceptions.
example_uz: Bu yerdagi qoidalar moslashuvchan emas; istisnolar yo'q.

definition_en: The quality of being unwilling or unable to change.
example_en: His inflexibility made it hard to negotiate a compromise.
example_uz: Uning moslashuvchanlik yo'qligi murosaga kelishni qiyinlashtirdi.

definition_en: Behavior that does not show proper care or concern for consequences.
example_en: The manager was fired for his irresponsibility with company funds.
example_uz: Menejer kompaniya mablag'lariga nisbatan mas'uliyatsizligi uchun ishdan bo'shatildi.

definition_en: Not able to do something; lacking the necessary ability.
example_en: He seemed incapable of admitting his mistakes.
example_uz: U xatolarini tan olishga qodir emasdek tuyulardi.

definition_en: In a way that provides physical ease or a relaxed feeling.
example_en: The whole family fit comfortably into the new car.
example_uz: Butun oila yangi mashinaga qulay tarzda sig'di.

definition_en: In a way that causes physical or mental unease.
example_en: The room was uncomfortably hot during the meeting.
example_uz: Yig'ilish davomida xona noqulay darajada issiq edi.

definition_en: The quality of being expected or foreseeable in advance.
example_en: The predictability of his schedule made planning easy.
example_uz: Uning jadvalining bashorat qilinuvchanligi rejalashtirishni osonlashtirdi.

definition_en: The quality of being impossible to know or predict in advance.
example_en: The unpredictability of the weather made the trip risky.
example_uz: Ob-havoning bashorat qilib bo'lmasligi sayohatni xavfli qildi.

definition_en: The quality of being cheap enough for people to be able to buy.
example_en: The affordability of the new phones attracted many customers.
example_uz: Yangi telefonlarning arzonligi ko'plab xaridorlarni jalb qildi.

definition_en: Too expensive for most people to be able to buy or pay for.
example_en: Housing in the city center has become unaffordable for many families.
example_uz: Shahar markazidagi uy-joy ko'plab oilalar uchun qo'l yetmas bo'lib qoldi.

definition_en: In a way that shows good judgment and practical thinking.
example_en: She invested her savings sensibly instead of spending it all at once.
example_uz: U jamg'armasini bir vaqtning o'zida sarflash o'rniga oqilona sarmoya qildi.

definition_en: The ability to adjust easily to new conditions or situations.
example_en: The company values adaptability in employees facing rapid change.
example_uz: Kompaniya tez o'zgarishlarga duch keladigan xodimlarda moslashuvchanlikni qadrlaydi.

definition_en: In a way that involves trying hard to win against others, or at a low market price.
example_en: The new store priced its products competitively to attract customers.
example_uz: Yangi do'kon mijozlarni jalb qilish uchun mahsulotlarini raqobatbardosh narxda belgiladi.

definition_en: The ability to compete successfully with others.
example_en: Lower taxes could improve the country's economic competitiveness.
example_uz: Soliqlarni kamaytirish mamlakatning iqtisodiy raqobatbardoshligini oshirishi mumkin.

definition_en: A person or company that competes with another, especially in business.
example_en: Our main competitor just launched a cheaper version of the product.
example_uz: Bizning asosiy raqibimiz mahsulotning arzonroq versiyasini chiqardi.

definition_en: Involving the participation of many people in decisions or activities.
example_en: The city adopted a participatory approach to urban planning.
example_uz: Shahar shaharsozlikda jamoaviy ishtirok yondashuvini qabul qildi.

definition_en: Relating to the distribution or sharing out of something.
example_en: Distributive justice concerns the fair allocation of resources in society.
example_uz: Taqsimlovchi adolat jamiyatda resurslarni adolatli taqsimlash bilan bog'liq.

definition_en: In a way that shows a desire to keep someone or something safe from harm.
example_en: The mother wrapped her arms protectively around her child.
example_uz: Ona bolasini himoya qiluvchi tarzda quchoqladi.

definition_en: In a thoughtful way, considering something carefully.
example_en: He spoke reflectively about the choices he had made in life.
example_uz: U hayotda qilgan tanlovlari haqida mulohaza yuritgan holda gapirdi.

definition_en: In a way that involves careful choosing rather than accepting everything.
example_en: The teacher selectively chose examples that matched the students' level.
example_uz: O'qituvchi talabalar darajasiga mos misollarni tanlab tanladi.

definition_en: Not aware of or caring about other people's feelings.
example_en: His insensitive comment hurt her feelings deeply.
example_uz: Uning beparvo izohi uni juda xafa qildi.

definition_en: A lack of awareness or concern for other people's feelings.
example_en: His insensitivity to her grief surprised everyone.
example_uz: Uning uning qayg'usiga nisbatan sezgirlik yo'qligi hammani hayron qoldirdi.

definition_en: In a way that is pleasing to look at or appealing.
example_en: The shop window was attractively decorated for the holidays.
example_uz: Do'kon vitrinasi bayramlar uchun jozibali tarzda bezatilgan edi.

definition_en: The quality of being pleasing or appealing to look at or consider.
example_en: The city's attractiveness to tourists has grown in recent years.
example_uz: So'nggi yillarda shaharning sayyohlar uchun jozibadorligi ortdi.

definition_en: Not pleasing to look at or consider; unappealing.
example_en: The offer seemed unattractive compared to the competitor's deal.
example_uz: Taklif raqibning shartnomasiga nisbatan jozibasiz tuyuldi.

definition_en: Not doing anything; not moving or working.
example_en: He has been physically inactive since the injury.
example_uz: U jarohatdan beri jismonan faol emas.

definition_en: The state of not being active or not doing anything.
example_en: Long periods of inactivity can be harmful to your health.
example_uz: Uzoq muddatli faolsizlik salomatligingizga zarar yetkazishi mumkin.

definition_en: The quality of being hopeful and confident about the future.
example_en: Her positivity helped the whole team stay motivated during hard times.
example_uz: Uning ijobiyligi qiyin paytlarda butun jamoani motivatsiyalangan holda ushlab turishga yordam berdi.

definition_en: A tendency to be pessimistic or focus on the bad side of things.
example_en: Try not to let his negativity affect your own mood.
example_uz: Uning salbiyligi o'z kayfiyatingizga ta'sir qilishiga yo'l qo'ymang.

definition_en: In a forceful, hostile, or determined way.
example_en: The dog barked aggressively at every stranger who passed.
example_uz: It har bir o'tayotgan notanish odamga tajovuzkorona hurdi.

definition_en: The quality of being forceful, hostile, or ready to attack.
example_en: The coach criticized the team's lack of aggressiveness on defense.
example_uz: Murabbiy jamoaning himoyadagi tajovuzkorlik yetishmasligini tanqid qildi.

definition_en: In a way that causes admiration because of skill, size, or quality.
example_en: She performed impressively at her first piano recital.
example_uz: U birinchi pianino kontsertida taassurot qoldiradigan tarzda chiqish qildi.

definition_en: In a way that clearly shows feelings or ideas.
example_en: The actor spoke expressively, conveying deep emotion in every line.
example_uz: Aktyor ta'sirchan tarzda gapirdi, har bir satrda chuqur hissiyotni ifoda etdi.

definition_en: The quality of clearly showing feelings, thoughts, or ideas.
example_en: The dancer's expressiveness captivated the entire audience.
example_uz: Raqqosaning ta'sirchanligi butun tomoshabinlarni maftun etdi.

definition_en: In a way that provides encouragement or emotional help to someone.
example_en: Her friends responded supportively when she shared the bad news.
example_uz: Do'stlari u yomon xabarni aytganda qo'llab-quvvatlagan holda javob berishdi.

definition_en: In a way that is helpful and intended to produce improvement.
example_en: The manager gave constructively worded feedback after the presentation.
example_uz: Menejer taqdimotdan so'ng konstruktiv tarzda ifodalangan fikr-mulohaza berdi.

definition_en: Causing great and often irreparable damage or harm.
example_en: The storm had a destructive effect on the coastal town.
example_uz: Bo'ron sohilbo'yi shaharchasiga buzg'unchi ta'sir ko'rsatdi.

definition_en: In a way that causes great damage or harm.
example_en: The fire spread destructively through the dry forest.
example_uz: Yong'in quruq o'rmon bo'ylab buzg'unchilik bilan tarqaldi.

definition_en: In a way that teaches or gives useful information.
example_en: The professor explained the theory instructively, using simple examples.
example_uz: Professor nazariyani oddiy misollar yordamida o'rgatuvchi tarzda tushuntirdi.

definition_en: The state of being limited to a particular group or single provider.
example_en: The brand's exclusivity is part of why customers pay so much for it.
example_uz: Brendning eksklyuzivligi mijozlar nima uchun shuncha ko'p to'lashining sabablaridan biri.

definition_en: In a way that includes everyone, especially people who might otherwise be left out.
example_en: The school designed its programs inclusively for students of all abilities.
example_uz: Maktab dasturlarini barcha qobiliyatdagi talabalar uchun hammani qamrab olgan holda ishlab chiqdi.

definition_en: The practice of including people who might otherwise be excluded or marginalized.
example_en: The company launched a new initiative to promote inclusivity in the workplace.
example_uz: Kompaniya ish joyida inklyuzivlikni rivojlantirish uchun yangi tashabbus boshladi.

definition_en: In a way that removes all doubt; definitely.
example_en: The test results proved conclusively that the drug was safe.
example_uz: Test natijalari dorivor vositaning xavfsiz ekanligini qat'iy ravishda isbotladi.

definition_en: In a way that shows the ability to make decisions quickly and firmly.
example_en: The captain acted decisively to avoid the collision.
example_uz: Kapitan to'qnashuvdan qochish uchun qat'iyat bilan harakat qildi.

definition_en: In a way that shows an inability to make decisions quickly or confidently.
example_en: He answered indecisively, unsure of what he really wanted.
example_uz: U nima xohlashini bilmay, ikkilanib javob berdi.

definition_en: The inability to make a decision quickly; hesitation.
example_en: Her indecision about the job offer frustrated her family.
example_uz: Uning ish taklifi haqidagi ikkilanishi oilasini asabiylashtirdi.

definition_en: In a sudden way, without thinking carefully about the consequences.
example_en: He impulsively bought the car without checking its price elsewhere.
example_uz: U narxini boshqa joyda tekshirmasdan mashinani o'ylamasdan sotib oldi.

definition_en: The tendency to act suddenly without careful thought.
example_en: His impulsiveness often got him into trouble as a teenager.
example_uz: O'smirlik davrida uning impulsivligi ko'pincha uni muammoga duchor qilardi.

definition_en: In a way that is intended to protect against attack or criticism.
example_en: She reacted defensively when asked about the missing money.
example_uz: Yo'qolgan pul haqida so'ralganda u himoyalanish maqsadida javob berdi.

definition_en: In a way that is rude or upsetting to other people.
example_en: He spoke so offensively that several guests left the party.
example_uz: U shunchalik xafa qiladigan tarzda gapirdiki, bir nechta mehmon bazmni tark etdi.

definition_en: To a great extent; covering a large area or wide range of subjects.
example_en: The professor has traveled extensively throughout Asia for her research.
example_uz: Professor tadqiqoti uchun Osiyo bo'ylab keng ko'lamda sayohat qildi.
